name: Franz Road–Retail Center Fund
desc: A proposed real estate fund covering Franz Road Storage and NorthFry Retail Center, with property-specific participation and a planned five-year hold.
detail: The proposed fund covers Franz Road Storage and NorthFry Retail Center. The current preliminary memorandum provides for separate property-level participation, income, expenses, reserves, and sale proceeds. Existing conventional property loans are intended to be retired at closing, with no continuing property debt modeled. The proposed hold is five years; sale timing and distributions are not guaranteed. Final structure and terms remain subject to current due diligence, definitive documents, and independent ethical review. The image depicts the NorthFry Retail Center component only. Tenant names and signage shown in the concept rendering are illustrative and do not confirm executed leases or current occupancy.
